Name: Hilkiah, Priest of Jeshua's Days
Summary: Hilkiah was a priestly course head in the days of Jeshua son of Jozadak. NOTE ON IDENTITY: this Hilkiah is not identified in the text with Hilkiah the high priest of Josiah's day or any other Hilkiah, so this profile covers only the Nehemiah 12:7 course head.
LifeLesson: The courses of priests kept worship ordered across generations.
